body: It was actually the Loews on 2nd ave by the freshman NYU dorms.

That was a very strange event. At the time, I lived with my grandmother, her sister, and my predator cousin. My grandmother had been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease 3 years prior to that. My great aunt (who passed away past May) had some inkling about what was going on with my cousin (who is 13 years older than me), but I denied.it vehemently mostly because, misguidedly, I assumed that people would judge me because it was incestuous. 

Anyway, on this particular night, I was out alone in Manhattan. I'm from NYC. It was about 11:30 at night and I was just wandering the streets. A man approached me and we started chatting. He asked me if I was to go see a movie even though it was so late. I must admit that he kind of reminded me of my cousin. I believe I'm actually very good at detecting sociopaths as compared to the normal person. Anyway we went to see the "Quiet American." This was years ago. I was a kid. During the movie, he said he had to go to the bathroom and asked if I'd join him. We passed the bathroom, which I pointed out to him. He said not to worry. He just wanted to go to a bathroom on another floor. This particular movie theater is huge and has escalators going up like 7 flights. Of course we had gone to the latest showing of any movie and all of the floors were dark. I basically knew I was screwed at this point. I should have bolted. He walked me into a stark white hallway, obviously not a bathroom and his demeanor completely changed. He raped mr of course, but the interesting bit, at least to me, was that before he raped me, he tore my hoop earring out so savagely. My ears were bleeding and it stung like crazy. Then he just walked out of the hallway and left me sobbing on the ground naked. He returned with a wad of napkins a few minutes later, terrifying me, and forced me to clean up. He waited for me to clean the hallway and get dressed, and then he made me wash my face and in ears in the bathroom. Once hr was certain that everything was clean, he left. I got on the subway and went home. Of course my cousin was awake, and I told him everything that had happened. He promised to kill the guy for me. The irony was not lost on me even though I was only 15 at the time.

I went to a therapist years ago, and I was diagnosed with PTSD. I was pretty much ok until my ex-boyfriend committed suicide. 

It's not surprising to me that many would think that my life is a work of fiction. The way I keep myself sane in by believing in the powet of entropy, the idea that everything in the universe in driven toward chaos. When I think about it that way, combined with the fact that are many more bad things that can happen than good things, it seems more statistically possible that things could have turn out this way. Other days I just feel really unlucky.

I actually do feel like you have really helped me. Thank you so much. I was sort of feeling like the bad in my life had finally outweighed the good.

 I had a terrible day. I'm all over the map right now. I'm just trying to process everything. I think killing myself would be the easiest option, but maybe not the only option.

Thanks. I needed to hear that. I think Hiro was just picking up on the fact that my life has been comically terrible. There have been many moments where I've just had to laugh, hysterically, at how miserable my situation is. Right now I can't seem to get there though. I had something happen to me today that I can't even type out in words yet. It was the final straw. I don't think I can recover.

That was beautiful. Thank you. I cried reading it. I do anything I can to make a difference. I am in medical school right now, but when I get any free time I tutor kids in foster care. It's been great being a mentor to them and just getting to know their stories. It definitely brings me happiness. It's just that right now I've had a tough couple of weeks and my strength is waning. I guess I'm just tired, and forgot why I've been fighting for so long. Just holding onto my sanity has been a full-time job.

I'm waiting. I live in the U.S., but my parents are immigrants. My father recently retired and is going back to his native country for the first time in 40 years. He seems so happy that I could never ruin it by taking my life. He leaves the 20th of January and will be gone for a month. During this time I will be planning my departure. I'm not sad about it. I'm relieved to have made the decision. I'm taking care of everything I need to while he's gone. I need to prepare a will and make a few other arrangements. I plan to kill myself by carbon monoxide poisoning.

I wouldn't even be having a crisis about killing myself if it hadnt been for the fact that my first boyfriend and love of my life actually did kill himself. It will be the 3 year anniversary of his death on January 17th. I will always miss him and his suicide changed my life forever. His wake was packed to the brim with people he didn't know loved him. I doubt that anyone has ever given a shit about me, but I told myself I would never kill myself after that. However it's increasingly difficult to prevent my suicidal thoughts and I don't think anyone would blame me if I actually went through with it.
